# The meadow round the tower (generated by make_env.py).
new
material new Grass --base-color 0.588 0.984 0.780 --no-slot
material new Path --base-color 0.847 0.749 0.847 --no-slot
add mesh plane --name Plain --size 1 --location 0 1 0
scale 18 16 1
apply --scale
material assign Grass
add mesh cone --name Knoll --vertices 10 --radius1 3.4 --radius2 2.3 --depth 0.36 --location 0 0 0.0
material assign Grass
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cube --name Flag0 --size 1 --location 0.250 -3.200 0.030
scale 0.600 0.450 0.100
apply --scale
set rotation 0.00 0.00 10.00
material assign Path
add mesh cube --name Flag1 --size 1 --location -0.250 -3.950 0.030
scale 0.600 0.450 0.100
apply --scale
set rotation 0.00 0.00 -10.00
material assign Path
add mesh cube --name Flag2 --size 1 --location 0.250 -4.700 0.030
scale 0.600 0.450 0.100
apply --scale
set rotation 0.00 0.00 10.00
material assign Path
add mesh cube --name Flag3 --size 1 --location -0.250 -5.450 0.030
scale 0.600 0.450 0.100
apply --scale
set rotation 0.00 0.00 -10.00
material assign Path
add mesh cube --name Flag4 --size 1 --location 0.250 -6.200 0.030
scale 0.600 0.450 0.100
apply --scale
set rotation 0.00 0.00 10.00
material assign Path
add mesh cube --name Flag5 --size 1 --location -0.250 -6.950 0.030
scale 0.600 0.450 0.100
apply --scale
set rotation 0.00 0.00 -10.00
material assign Path
select all
shade flat
export ground.glb
